visual.description: White background used for the main navigation bar and modal overlay.
Pure black used for the cookie policy modal heading and navigation text.
Near-black used for body copy text within the cookie policy modal.
Dark charcoal fill for the primary 'Agree' button background.
Off-white/light grey used as the modal surface background.
White background for 'Configure All Cookies' and 'Allow Technical Cookies Only' secondary buttons with dark border.
Black border used on secondary action buttons in the cookie modal.
Desaturated warm grey dominant tone of the hero background image showing a model in a dark blazer.
Blue underline link color used for 'Google's Privacy & Terms site' and 'Cookie Policy' inline links.
